title: Coming Home: Bringing Global Experience Back to Hungary
grammar: Preverbs haza- and vissza- expressing return, repatriation, and re-integration (hazatér, hazatelepül, visszailleszkedik)
goal: I can analyze current trends in return migration and the reintegration challenges faced by returning Hungarians.
I can master preverbs haza- and vissza- to express repatriation, return, and social re-adaptation.
I can discuss knowledge transfer, reverse culture shock, and international professional practices brought back to Hungary.
